about_the_game:
About This Game

VanVive Together: Survival RV is a wild co-op survival adventure where teamwork, creativity, and chaos collide. Build and customize your caravan, repair and upgrade your van, and brave dynamic landscapes while scavenging for food and supplies. Survive together, or don’t survive at all — the choice is yours!

How to Play

The game is designed for 1–8 players. Team up with friends to tackle the challenges of the open road: repair your van, gather resources, fend off zombies, and explore ever-changing trails.

Customize Your Caravan – Build and upgrade your rolling home to fit your style and survival needs.

Repair & Tune Your Van – Keep your engine running and your caravan in top shape for the long journey.

Explore Dynamic Landscapes – Discover new trails, secret locations, and hidden treasures.

Co-op Survival Chaos – Work together (or argue) as you gather food, fight zombies, and survive the elements.

Dynamic Weather & Day/Night Cycle – Adapt to harsh conditions and plan your moves wisely.

Gather Resources & Expand – Gather food and water, collect health packs, rev up your engine, and expand your caravan with new trails.

That is your adventure!

Every decision matters: share the road, split resources, and keep your crew alive. The open road is full of danger, surprises, and hilarious moments — are you ready to VanVive Together?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i3-6100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 750 Ti / AMD RX 560 (≥ 2 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable connection
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6 GB / AMD RX 580 8 GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 8 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Stable connection

short_description: Rev up, repair, and refuel! Gather food, discover dynamic landscapes, customize your ride, and uncover hidden treasures with your friends (1-8 CO-OP) in VanVive Together: Survival RV!
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Dutch, Norwegian, Portuguese - Brazil, Portuguese - Portugal, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America, Swedish, Turkish
